info.title: Knutepunkt API
info.description:
Velferdsteknologisk knutepunkt (VKP)

Velferdsteknologisk knutepunkt (VKP) is a service that manages the flow of information between welfare technology solutions and electronic patient journals (EPJ).

The service is secured with HelseID.

API for sending and receiving information from EPJ systems based on FHIR R4 profiles

post.description:
Scope

nhn:vkp/api/user/bundle.write

Description

A Bundle is a collection of other FHIR-resources, sent as one single message. A Bundle can represent different types of messages, depending on the combination of FHIR resources it contains.

One specific combination of FHIR resources representing a valid VKP message contains a number of mandatory FHIR resources and possibly some optional ones. Optional resources are typically used for additional information about auxiliary elements, such as practitioner and device, when name/id is not sufficient.

The following resources can be contained in a valid VKP Bundle:

  • DetectedIssue - represents a notification/varsel from welfare technology
  • Composition - represent a journal note/journalnotat, typically text written by an employee/health care worker
  • Device - sensor, camera, safety alarm etc.
  • Practitioner - an employee/health care worker
  • Encounter - the vkpEncounter profile represents a digital (camera) encounter / digitalt (kamera-) tilsyn
  • Observation - vital signs and other measurements / måledata. Can also represent a score/poengsum related to a QuestionnaireRespone
  • QuestionnaireResponse - the patient's response to a questionnaire / skjemabesvarelse.

Expected input

Messages representing various types of journal notes, written by a health care worker/employee. These must have Bundle.type = Document, and the first resource must be a Composition. Optional resources are shown in parentheses:

  • Oppfølging av varsel (notification and follow-up): DetectedIssue, Composition, (Device, Practitioner)
  • Oppfølging av varsel om måling (notification and follow-up on observations): DetectedIssue, Composition, Observation, Practitioner
  • Oppfølging av varsel om skjemasvarelse (notification and follow-up on questionnaire responses): DetectedIssue, Composition, QuestionnaireResponse, (Observation, Practitioner)
  • Planlagt digitalt tilsyn / kameratilsyn (planned digital encounter): Encounter, Composition, (Device, Practitioner)
  • Hendelsesbasert digitalt tilsyn / kameratilsyn (event-based digital encounter): DetectedIssue, Encounter, Composition, (Device, Practitioner)
  • Frittstående notat (standalone note): Composition, Practitioner

Messages representing only (patient reported) data. These must have Bundle.type = Collection.

  • Måledata - Observation(s)

Supported EPJs

  • CosDoc
  • Gerica
  • Visma Profil
  • Epic

Fhir-resources

  • Bundle
  • DetectedIssue - represents a notification/varsel from welfare technology
  • Composition - represent a journal note/journalnotat, typically text written by an employee/health care worker
  • Device - sensor, camera, safety alarm etc.
  • Practitioner - an employee/health care worker
  • Encounter - the vkpEncounter profile represents a digital (camera) encounter / digitalt (kamera-) tilsyn
  • Observation - vital signs and other measurements / måledata. Can also represent a score/poengsum related to a QuestionnaireResponse
  • QuestionnaireResponse - the patient's response to a questionnaire / skjemabesvarelse.

post.description:
Scope

nhn:vkp/api/user/careplan.read

Description

Retrieve visitation schedule for a patient in a specified time period, i.e. completed, ongoing and planned physical visits.

In Visma Profil it is possible to set a limit for how many hours forwards and back in time external parties are allowed to retrieve visits from. If these limits are activated in Profil they will override any parameters that exceed the number of hours sent to VKP.

Tieto Gerica currently only returns ongoing and planned visitis, completed visitis are not returned.

Supported EPJs

  • CosDoc
  • Gerica
  • Visma Profil
  • Epic

Fhir-resources

  • Bundle
  • CarePlan

requestBody.description:
The patient.identifier parameter must be a valid norwegian national identity number.

The date parameter must consist of two values, a from date and a to date.

date

  • Format: [prefix]yyyy-mm-ddThh:mm:ss[.mmm][Z|(+|-)hh:mm]
  • From date prefix: gt, ge, sa
  • To date prefix: lt, le, eb
More information here: https://www.hl7.org/fhir/search.html#prefix

patient.identifier

  • Format: [system-id|]person-id
  • If [system-id] is omitted, it is assumed a norwegian identification number has been submitted.
  • Must be valid according to the mod11-criterias.
  • Valid system identification:
    • Fødselsnummer: urn:oid:2.16.578.1.12.4.1.4.1
    • D-nummer: urn:oid:2.16.578.1.12.4.1.4.2
    • Felles-hjelpenummer: urn:oid:2.16.578.1.12.4.1.4.3

Scope

nhn:vkp/api/user/composition.write

Description

A Composition represents a standalone note / frittstående notat and is used to send a journal note without any other context (such as Practitioner or DetectedIssue). If a Practitioner resource is needed to represent more information about the author or any other resources are needed to represent context, a Bundle interface must be used.

Supported EPJs

  • CosDoc
  • Gerica
  • Visma Profil
  • Epic

Fhir-resources

  • Composition

Scope

nhn:vkp/api/user/episodeofcare.read

Description

Retrieves health care services (tjenester) for one or more patients. Returns a Bundle containing a list of EpisodeOfCare resources, representing services. For each EpisodeOfCare, the field patient.identifier is included.

If _include is set to EpisodeOfCare:patient, information about the patients are also returned. Each patient is returned using the VkpPatients profile.

Supported EPJ's

  • CosDoc
  • Gerica
  • Visma Profil
  • Epic

Fhir-resources

  • Bundle
  • Condition
